theorem_rows.name: template_void_exclusion_by_union_prime_supply
theorem_rows.statement: A forced void template is excluded once its union of fixed q=P-2b atom intervals contains at least one prime q.

theorem_rows.name: contiguous_template_to_backward_sqrt_gap
theorem_rows.statement: If the template covers every odd q in its hull, its exclusion is a backward prime-gap bound below P with length equal to the hull depth.

theorem_rows.name: punctured_template_to_shape_union_supply
theorem_rows.statement: If the template does not cover the whole hull, its exclusion is a punctured fixed-shape union prime-supply input.

theorem_rows.name: finite_no_template_void
theorem_rows.statement: The finite audit finds that every listed template union actually contains at least one prime.

theorem_rows.name: global_fixed_shape_union_supply
theorem_rows.statement: A global proof still needs the fixed-shape union prime-supply theorem, or an external sqrt-scale prime-gap input strong enough to imply it.

plain_conclusion: 本步把固定小 k 形状 PDEC 的最后数学输入边界写清：每个强制 prime-void 模板，只要其固定 q 区间并集含一个素数就被排除。若模板覆盖整个奇 q hull，则这正是 P 下方长度 depth 的后向素数间隙输入；若存在覆盖缺口，则是更精细的穿孔固定形状并集素数供给输入。有限账本中所有模板并集实际都含素数，但全局仍未证明。

decision_rows.meaning: 每个强制空模板只要自身并集含素数即可排除。
连续 hull 模板已等价为 P 下方 sqrt 级后向素数间隙输入。
有限样本中所有模板并集都含素数。
仍需全局证明固定形状并集素数供给，或引用同等强度短区间素数输入。
本步只标定最终输入边界，不关闭全局行/列命题。
